description: This PHP file provides the admin interface for managing products in an e-commerce application. It includes functionalities for adding new products with images, deleting existing products, and displaying the list of added products.

methods.name: add_product
methods.description: Handles the submission of new product details, sanitizes inputs, checks for duplicate product names, inserts new product into database, and uploads images.

methods.name: delete_product
methods.description: Deletes a product based on ID, removes associated images from the server, and cleans related entries in cart and wishlist tables.
